Runerigus

Ground Ghost

Galar · Generation 8

Runerigus is a Ground/Ghost-type Grudge Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 66.6 kg. It evolves from Yamask. Its highest base stat is Defense (145), with a base stat total of 483.
